name: Kerala
description: Kerala, widely known as God's Own Country, is a tropical paradise featuring serene palm-fringed backwaters, spice-covered Western Ghats hill stations, and Ayurvedic wellness centers.

cuisine.name: Avial
cuisine.desc: Thick mixture of local vegetables and coconut seasoned with coconut oil and curry leaves.

cuisine.name: Karimeen Pollichathu
cuisine.desc: Pearl spot fish marinated in spicy paste, wrapped inside banana leaves and grilled.

streetFood.name: Pazham Pori
streetFood.desc: Crispy sweet ripe banana fritters fried in light turmeric batter.

streetFood.name: Thattu Dosa
streetFood.desc: Small, thick dosas served hot with spicy coconut chutney and sambar.

desserts.name: Ada Pradhaman
desserts.desc: Traditional sweet payasam made of rice flakes, sweet jaggery syrup, and fresh coconut milk.

desserts.name: Unniyappam
desserts.desc: Small sweet round fritter made of rice, jaggery, banana, and roasted coconut pieces.

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.desc: Annual harvest festival celebrated with grand floral carpets and elaborate Sadya feasts.

festivals.name: Vishu
festivals.desc: Malayali New Year celebrated withVishukkani arrangements bringing good luck.

hiddenGems.name: Marari Beach
hiddenGems.desc: Under-developed clean white sand beach close to Alappuzha backwaters.

hiddenGems.name: Gavi
hiddenGems.desc: Quiet eco-tourism forest village famous for pristine lake boat rides and wildlife sightings.

topDestinations.name: Munnar
topDestinations.desc: Famous hill station carpeted with sprawling green tea plantations and cool mist valleys.

topDestinations.name: Alappuzha Houseboats
topDestinations.desc: Cruising through narrow canal channels inside traditional thatched-roof wooden boats.

travelTips: Always reserve houseboat bookings in advance during peak Winter months
Ayurvedic treatments should only be taken from government-accredited centers

Winter.weatherDesc: Warm, sunny days with low humidity. Perfect for cruising on houseboats and swimming in Kovalam beaches.

food.name: Kerala Sadya
food.desc: Elaborate vegetarian feast served on banana leaves.

locations.name: Alappuzha Backwaters
locations.highlight: Serene boat cruising in winter breeze.

travelTips: Advance booking is mandatory for all major winter destinations

Spring.weatherDesc: Pleasant moderate temperatures across the Western Ghats hills, blooming wild valley flowers.

food.name: Puttu with Kadala Curry
food.desc: Steamed rice cake cylinders served alongside spicy black chickpeas.

travelTips: Carry lightweight cottons with a light sweater for hill nights

Summer.weatherDesc: Hot and highly humid conditions along coastal lines. Shaded forest valleys like Periyar Tiger Reserve are cooler.

food.name: Sambharam
food.desc: Cooling spiced buttermilk infused with ginger and curry leaves.

locations.name: Thekkady Periyar Reserve
locations.highlight: Bamboo rafting rides inside cool forest rivers.

travelTips: Drink plenty of coconut water to prevent heat dehydration

Monsoon.weatherDesc: Heavy pouring rain, rich wet greenery, roaring full waterfalls. Excellent season for traditional Ayurvedic therapies.

food.name: Karkidaka Kanji
food.desc: Medicinal rice porridge loaded with restorative spices.

locations.name: Athirappilly Waterfalls
locations.highlight: Spectacular roaring waterfalls at peak flow.

travelTips: Ayurveda treatments are highly recommended during this cool monsoon weather

weatherWarnings: Torrential flash flooding risk in July-August
Rough sea warnings for coastal fishermen

accessibility.comments: Access is mostly limited in boats, but premium resorts offer ramp access.
